description: Variation of condition 2 (compliance with approved drawings) of planning permission 26/04240 (Variation of Condition 17 (Sustainable Urban Drainage System (SuDS)-Implementation) of planning permission PP/26/01567 (Demolition of existing ground floor conservatory extension in favour of new lower-ground and ground floor extension; lowering lower ground floor level of house; ASHP units; double glazed timber windows; re-instatement of lost features to front fa‡ade; landscaping works and other associated works and alterations to property) to reflect revised drainage strategy.) to allow the partial demolition of the closet wing at the first, second and third floors, and the closet wing roof; and its reinstatement to its existing form, footprint, height and fenestration, in brickwork, mortar and detailing to match existing; it is deemed to be the more favourable approach by the structural engineers and temporary works designers, because of the demolition works going on underneath at lower ground and ground floor levels.
